description: Strict mathematical parity breakdown for Virtual and Portfolio execution modes

reconciliation_v3_04_vs_v3_05.explanation: The -$61.33 delta between V3-04 (+$343.52) and V3-05 (+$282.19) stems from: (1) V3-04 Portfolio mode was not independent; it reused Virtual mode exit times and summed isolated PnLs without genuine VWAP order blending. (2) V3-05 implemented the true independent portfolio event loop with dynamic VWAP, real margin checking, and tick-by-tick combo concurrency, resulting in 8 fewer ETH legs (-$2.00 difference from Virtual) and realistic position blending.
